memory_update.text: Fabrinet is the highest-priority direct public proxy for optical interconnect EMS and precision manufacturing, but current market cap has moved into large-cap territory; future layers should focus on revenue purity, customer concentration, Thailand capacity, and 800G/1.6T datacom mix.

Jabil should remain in the universe as a broader EMS platform with explicit photonics, 800G, silicon-photonics, and 1.6T exposure; the key coverage gap is whether optical interconnect revenue is financially material inside the larger company.

Coherent and Lumentum are key reference leaders for the 800G/1.6T optics ecosystem and validate demand for photonics components, but this pass did not include them as candidates because they are highly visible optical product leaders rather than the clearest underfollowed EMS/manufacturing bottleneck names.

Layer 2 should explicitly separate AI datacenter optical manufacturing exposure from legacy telecom, CATV, industrial photonics, and generalized EMS revenue; candidates with no quantified 800G/1.6T or hyperscaler evidence should be downgraded.

node: Optical interconnect EMS and precision manufacturing for 800G and 1.6T transceivers
summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe for the optical interconnect EMS and precision-manufacturing node. The strongest direct exposure remains Fabrinet as the purest public optical manufacturing partner, while Jabil offers a broader EMS/photonic manufacturing platform with explicit 800G/1.6T positioning. Applied Optoelectronics adds direct module-manufacturing exposure through 800G hyperscale transceiver orders. Aeluma is included only as a speculative shadow candidate because its III-V-on-silicon photonics platform could address upstream InP/photodetector capacity constraints, but commercial AI datacenter revenue evidence still needs verification. Coherent and Lumentum are important reference leaders for the optical component and transceiver ecosystem, but they are not included in the four-candidate list because this pass prioritizes EMS/manufacturing and underfollowed discovery over already highly visible optical leaders.
